CustomField.description: Deterministic pre-decline for structurally unanswerable cases, decided BEFORE the metered generation call. Declines (NO_DRAFT_LOW_CONFIDENCE) when the case references a screenshot/attachment but its text carries no machine-matchable error evidence, or describes a previously-working setup breaking ("worked yesterday") with no error text and no platform-release mention. These were the dominant bad-draft family on unseen cohorts (2026-07-23): the gates let them through and the draft answers the general topic, not the customer's unseen error. Default false in code; the Default record turns it on.
CustomField.label: Draft Structural Decline Enabled
